title: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo) real-world limits: NPU unused by llama.cpp, image/video gen 5x slower than DGX Spark, memory partitioning caps GPU at ~96 GB of 128 GB LPDDR5X
summary: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo APU, 50 TOPS NPU). common LLMs + image/video gen models. Runtime: llama.cpp (NPU not utilized). Métricas: N/A (qualitative + comparative: 5x slower gen vs NVIDIA DGX Spark). Uso: local inference on integrated AMD APU / Strix Halo laptops or mini-PCs. Límite: llama.cpp ignores built-in NPU; image/video generation painfully slow; GPU cannot access full 128 GB unified memory (max ~96 GB after partitioning/reboot). Por qué importa: Ground-truth user report on current software ecosystem gaps for AMD's new high-TOPS consumer APU. Builders targeting Strix Halo hardware should expect CPU/GPU fallback only and test memory configs; NVIDIA DGX Spark significantly faster for gen workloads.
